result.title: Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering
result.summary: Agentic knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires large language models (LLMs) to solve complex questions through multi-turn interactions with a knowledge graph (KG). Outcome-supervised reinforcement learning derives verifiable outcome rewards from final answers but uniformly assigns each rollout's outcome-level advantage to all policy-generated tokens, creating a trajectory-to-operation mismatch since KG operations within a rollout can have varying effects on the search process and final answer. To address this, we propose Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation (OACR), which employs a training-only KG-state outcome model to estimate outcome-reward changes between adjacent KG search states and converts them into operation credit, from which token-wise weights are derived. These multiplicative weights reallocate token-level update magnitudes while preserving the sign of the outcome-level advantage at every generated token. Across three benchmarks, OACR achieves stronger overall performance than existing KGQA methods while using fewer inference-time LLM calls and tokens.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出 agentic KGQA 中结果监督 RL 把整条 rollout 的结果优势均匀摊给所有生成 token，造成「轨迹—操作」错配；为此提出 OACR，用仅训练时的 KG 状态结果模型估计相邻搜索状态间的奖励变化，转为操作级 credit 并派生 token 权重，在保持优势符号不变的前提下重分配更新幅度，在三个基准上以更少推理调用和 token 取得更好整体表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其轨迹级优势与操作级贡献错配的诊断、以及相邻状态 credit 差异化的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的贡献分配与步级监督提供可供核查的线索；但研究对象是 KG/文本智能体而非视觉推理，能否迁移到多模态 latent 状态仍需自行判断。
